note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because three record families share this destination and no two of them agree on `meta`, on `reward`, or on which extra top-level fields exist: 7668 on-call RCA episodes carry `kind` / `false_lead` / `rca` / `remediate` with `meta` `{alert_source, factory, generator, plant, round, ticket}`, 20 OpenSRE seed rows carry `true_root_cause` / `red_herring` (and `forbidden_diagnosis` / `required_evidence` on subsets of those 20) with `meta` `{factory, generator, opensre_seed, round}`, and 16 dest-stamped search-index `sir-*` rows carry none of them with `meta` `{designed, domain, factory, generator, kind, round, seed, stack}`, so the datasets-server infers one shape from an early shard and then cannot cast the other two. Declaring the union fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: plan
features.note: on all 7704 records and always a plain string: never absent, never a list

features.name: kind
features.note: present on 7668 of 7704 records, always the literal `episode`. Absent on the 20 OpenSRE seed rows and on the 16 `sir-*` rows disclosed below, which carry `meta.kind` instead

features.name: true_root_cause
features.note: present on 20 of 7704 records — every OpenSRE seed row and only those; always a plain string

features.name: red_herring
features.note: present on the same 20 OpenSRE seed rows; always a plain string

features.name: forbidden_diagnosis
features.note: present on 16 of those 20 OpenSRE seed rows, not all of them; always a plain string

features.name: required_evidence
features.note: present on only 2 of those 20 OpenSRE seed rows (`irc-r02-b-replag-cpu-analytics`, `irc-r02-b-failover-stale-writer-dns`); always a list of strings

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool — `command` (bash), `url` plus optional `query` / `retry` / `method` (fetch), `path` (read), `path` + `contents` (write), `path` + `old` + `new` (edit), `args` (pytest)

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag over 22 distinct key sets: `success` on every record, and the 7668 on-call episodes carry exactly `{false_lead_steps, http_retries, steps, success}`. The 36 OpenSRE and `sir-*` rows drop those three and add `cost_steps` (36), `plan_changes` (16), `tests_passed` (16), `handoff` (15), `red_herring_dismissed` (14), `retries` (8), `xfailed` (8), `forbidden_diagnosis_avoided` (4), `p99_s_after` (4), `instance_class_unchanged` (3), `replica_lag_s_after` (3), `five_xx_rps_end` (2), `missing_metric` (2), `wrong_mitigation_rollback` (2) and 14 single-record extras. `handoff` is itself type-varying: an integer on the 8 `sir-*` rows and a team-name string on 7 OpenSRE rows

features.name: false_lead
features.note: present on 7668 of 7704 records — the on-call RCA family and only it; always an object with exactly these three keys

features.name: rca
features.note: present on the same 7668 on-call RCA episodes; always a plain string

features.name: remediate
features.note: present on the same 7668 on-call RCA episodes; always a plain string

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag with exactly three shapes: `factory`, `generator`, `round` on every record, plus `alert_source` / `plant` / `ticket` on the 7668 on-call episodes, `opensre_seed` on the 20 OpenSRE seed rows, and `designed` / `domain` / `kind` / `seed` / `stack` on the 16 `sir-*` rows

disclosures: The 7704 published records split into three families by payload, not by slug: 7668 on-call leftover-signal RCA episodes (`kind` + `false_lead` + `rca` + `remediate`), 20 OpenSRE seed rows (`true_root_cause` + `red_herring`), and the 16 dest-stamped search-index rows disclosed below. Every record declares `meta.factory` `incident-response-oncall-factory` and `meta.generator` `grok-4.6`.

disclosures.summary: Sixteen records published into rounds r3382-r3389 of this destination are search-index-rebuild leftover3c episodes, not incident-response episodes: their ids carry the `sir-` prefix, their `meta` is the search-index mill's `{designed, domain, kind, seed, stack}` shape, and their goals are Meilisearch / Typesense / Sonic / Tantivy / Xapian / Manticore / Zinc / OpenSearch rebuild-and-handoff tickets. The mill rewrites `meta.factory` to the destination it hopped into, which is why they are stamped `incident-response-oncall-factory`. They are kept exactly as generated and are not re-censused here. They are outside the frozen mill censuses of the related issues, which cover other destinations.

disclosures: The 20 OpenSRE seed rows are `incident-response-oncall-factory` episodes generated by `grok-4.6`, same as the rest of the destination; they are an alternate RCA labelling (`true_root_cause` / `red_herring` instead of `false_lead` / `rca` / `remediate`), not foreign payload. They are not confined to the opening rounds: they sit in rounds r2, r681-r684, r760-r762, r770 and r775, two per round, and each names its seed in `meta.opensre_seed`.

The 113 `irc-*` records whose id contains `leftover` (and the 1701 `irc-*` records whose goal does) are this factory's own advertised leftover-signal mechanic, not a foreign dump: they run from r96 through r3125, usually one every twentieth round. Across the complete 7704-record destination, 1717 goals contain `leftover` because all 16 dest-stamped `sir-*` rows disclosed above do too; those 16 remain a separate foreign-payload class. The `irc-*` rows carry the standard on-call shape and are not disclosed as mill mix.
Every one of the 139086 steps publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
